sources.label: Official self-portrait product-page Size guide (Body measurement tab, cm)

audit: self-portrait-studio.com/pages/size-guide 404s; brand site is self-portrait.com. Its Size Conversion Chart has no body numbers; the product-page Size guide 'Body measurement' tab prints bust/waist/hip in cm for sizes 4-16 (same on a lace top and a lace maxi dress; the 'Garment measurement' tab is not used). UK/US/FR from the conversion chart (FR stored as EU). Old UK 10 85/66/90 -> 88/73/99; UK 14 93/74/98 -> 98/83/109; UK 16 97/78/102 -> 103/88/114. UK 4 added.
